healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Calendly connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

users.me.action.title: Get Current User
users.me.action.description: Retrieve the profile information for the authenticated Calendly user, including name, email, timezone, and scheduling URL.

user.description: The authenticated user's profile resource from Calendly.

event_types.list.title: List Event Types
event_types.list.description: Retrieve all active event types belonging to a specific Calendly user or organization.

user.description: The URI of the user whose event types to list (e.g. https://api.calendly.com/users/AAAA).

organization.description: Optional. The URI of the organization to filter event types.

count.description: Optional. Number of results to return (max 100).

pageToken.description: Optional. Token for paginating to the next result set.

scheduled_events.list.title: List Scheduled Events
scheduled_events.list.description: Retrieve a list of scheduled events for a Calendly user or organization, with optional filters for status, date range, and pagination.

user.description: Optional. The URI of the user whose scheduled events to list.

organization.description: Optional. The URI of the organization to filter events.

status.description: Optional. Filter by event status: active or canceled.

count.description: Optional. Number of results to return (max 100).

pageToken.description: Optional. Token for paginating to the next result set.

minStartTime.description: Optional. ISO 8601 minimum start time filter.

maxStartTime.description: Optional. ISO 8601 maximum start time filter.

scheduled_events.get.title: Get Scheduled Event
scheduled_events.get.description: Retrieve the details of a single Calendly scheduled event by its UUID.

uuid.description: The UUID of the scheduled event to retrieve.

scheduled_events.invitees.list.title: List Event Invitees
scheduled_events.invitees.list.description: Retrieve all invitees for a specific Calendly scheduled event, with optional filters for status and email.

uuid.description: The UUID of the scheduled event whose invitees to list.

status.description: Optional. Filter by invitee status: active or canceled.

count.description: Optional. Number of results to return (max 100).

pageToken.description: Optional. Token for paginating to the next result set.

email.description: Optional. Filter invitees by email address.

scheduled_events.cancel.title: Cancel Scheduled Event
scheduled_events.cancel.description: Cancel a Calendly scheduled event by its UUID, optionally providing a cancellation reason.

uuid.description: The UUID of the scheduled event to cancel.

reason.description: Optional. The reason for canceling the event.

cancellation.description: The cancellation resource returned by Calendly.

invitee_no_shows.create.title: Mark Invitee as No-Show
invitee_no_shows.create.description: Mark a Calendly event invitee as a no-show by creating an invitee_no_show record for their invitee URI.

invitee.description: The full URI of the invitee to mark as a no-show (e.g. https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/{uuid}/invitees/{uuid}).

scheduling_links.create.title: Create Scheduling Link
scheduling_links.create.description: Create a single-use or multi-use Calendly scheduling link for a specific event type, enabling one-time or limited booking URLs.

owner.description: The URI of the event type that owns this scheduling link (e.g. https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAA).

ownerType.description: The type of the owner resource. Must be EventType.

maxEventCount.description: Optional. Maximum number of events that can be booked with this link.

link.description: The created scheduling link resource, including the booking_url.

slots.available.title: Get Available Times
slots.available.description: Retrieve available booking times for a Calendly event type within a date range (max 7 days, must be in the future).

eventType.description: The Calendly event type URI to check availability for.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of the availability window (future, within 7 days of end).

end.description: ISO 8601 end of the availability window.

bookings.create.title: Create Booking
bookings.create.description: Book a Calendly event for an invitee directly, without the Calendly UI. Requires a paid Calendly plan.

eventType.description: The Calendly event type URI to book.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start time (UTC) of the booking.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone of the invitee (e.g. America/New_York).

location.description: Optional. Meeting location object (e.g. { kind, details }).

guests.description: Optional. Up to 10 additional guest emails.
